# The Heritage Foundation

> A leading conservative think tank providing policy research, analysis, and advocacy on American values, national security, and constitutional governance.

The Heritage Foundation is a prominent conservative policy research organization that publishes analysis on domestic and foreign policy issues, hosts events, and engages supporters through membership and advocacy programs. The site serves as a resource hub for conservative perspectives on topics ranging from election integrity and border security to education freedom and geopolitical strategy.

## Key Topics

- Conservative policy
- National security
- American values
- Election integrity
- Border security
- Education freedom
- China policy
- Foreign policy
- Government regulation
- Constitutional governance
- Geopolitics
- Economic freedom
- Family policy
- Think tank research
- Policy commentary

## Domestic Policy

- [Election Integrity](https://www.heritage.org/election-integrity): Election integrity resources including fraud database and scorecard
- [Border Security](https://www.heritage.org/border-security): Border security and immigration policy analysis and resources
- [Education](https://www.heritage.org/education): Education freedom and school choice policy resources
- [Life](https://www.heritage.org/life): Pro-life policy resources and state protections for unborn children
- [Big Tech](https://www.heritage.org/big-tech): Big Tech regulation policy and online safety resources
- [Government Regulation](https://www.heritage.org/government-regulation): Regulatory reform and overregulation policy analysis

## Foreign Policy & Global Security

- [China](https://www.heritage.org/china): China policy analysis and resources on countering CCP threats
- [Europe](https://www.heritage.org/europe): European security, NATO relations, and Ukraine policy analysis
- [Middle East](https://www.heritage.org/middle-east): Middle East security threats and Iran policy analysis
- [Global Politics](https://www.heritage.org/global-politics): Global politics and U.S. foreign policy strategy resources
- [Antisemitism](https://www.heritage.org/antisemitism): Heritage position on antisemitism and support for Israel

## Foundational Principles & Ideology

- [American History](https://www.heritage.org/american-history): American founding principles and constitutional guidance resources
- [Conservatism](https://www.heritage.org/conservatism): Conservative ideology and founding principles explained
- [Progressivism](https://www.heritage.org/progressivism): Conservative critique of progressive ideology and policies

## Policy Resources & Tools

- [Explore Policy](https://www.heritage.org/explore-policy): Policy explorer tool for browsing Heritage research topics

## About & Engagement

- [Homepage](https://www.heritage.org): Homepage for The Heritage Foundation conservative think tank
- [About Heritage | Mission](https://www.heritage.org/about-heritage/mission): Mission and values of The Heritage Foundation
- [Events](https://www.heritage.org/events): Upcoming events and policy discussions hosted by Heritage
- [Press](https://www.heritage.org/press): Press releases and news statements from Heritage Foundation
- [Renew Membership](https://secured.heritage.org/renew-membership): Membership renewal and donation page for supporters
